judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a draft spec, a `.lore/dod.md` file, and three failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`, without making any production code changes at all. Because `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` and `package.json` (`ajv`) were never updated, two of the three new tests fail immediately and none of the validation logic exists. Beyond missing the entire implementation, the candidate explicitly declared core ticket requirements (schema compilation at registration, dynamic schema caching, orchestrator tool-loop retry tests, log redaction checks, documentation updates, and `CHANGELOG.md`) out of scope in its DoD. The only alignment with the reference is the creation of `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` and basic test cases targeting `ToolRegistry.execute`.
